responsibility: Declares the analyzer subsystem responsible for saving, deduplicating, path-selecting, and emitting diagnostics after graph construction. It defines saved_diagnostic records, including pending_diagnostic ownership and best-path caching, and the diagnostic_manager API that accepts candidate warnings and notes, computes emission paths from exploded_graph data, and performs path building and pruning before producing final GCC diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Declares saved_diagnostic and diagnostic_manager as the analyzer’s stored-warning and emission-control interfaces, whereas diagnostic-manager.cc performs the actual path finding, pruning, and report emission work.
